remarks: Welcome to 2895 Dorman Street in Camarillo! This inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom highly upgraded home features an open-concept floor plan, a beautifully remodeled kitchen, and a private backyard with inviting outdoor living spaces. Newer exterior paint, newer windows, a new sliding glass door, and luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout create a fresh, updated feel. The custom remodeled kitchen showcases cherry wood shaker-style cabinetry with soft-close doors and drawers, premium Taj Mahal Quartz countertops, a stylish herringbone backsplash, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, a microwave with built-in hood vent, reverse osmosis and a deep-basin stainless steel sink.
